criteria.description: Primary mega disclosure and mobile toggle reach closed, open, navigation-open, and nested-open states via selector-driven interactions on [data-rmf-root]
Exactly one primary links tree (#rmf-primary-links / ul.ren-nav-links) serves desktop and mobile — no duplicated responsive branches
Exactly four direct children of #rmf-primary-links (> li count === 4): three ordinary ren-nav-link destinations plus one mega details/summary trigger
Exactly one visible mega chevron (.rmf-chevron); classless summary::after must be neutralized
Open panel exposes exactly 3 groups × 4 destinations = 12 .rmf-dest anchors with titles; one .rmf-feature promotional item; one .rmf-view-all see-all control
Featured media (.rmf-feature-media) maintains approximately 16:9 aspect ratio (±0.2) on desktop open state
Featured promo is a single real anchor without nested button or role=button descendants
Mega summary shares the centerY axis with peer primary links within 2px
Desktop panel sits under the bar (absolute); mobile panel stays in-flow; no horizontal overflow on html
Mobile primary rows are full-width and start-aligned without nested-card details chrome
Summary opens by click/Enter/Space; Escape closes and restores focus to SUMMARY

Desktop (≥48rem) pointer hover opens the mega disclosure; pointer remains open when moving from summary into the panel (stable close region); leaving the disclosure+panel hit region closes the disclosure. Hover is additive to click/Enter/Space, not a replacement.
With JavaScript disabled on mobile, the single tree, twelve destinations, featured item, and see-all remain usable via native disclosure
Visible interactive targets inside [data-rmf-root] meet 44×44 in a touch context
prefers-reduced-motion disables block-local transitions and animations on panel/chevron/dest/feature
Featured mega menu preview passes axe WCAG 2.1 A/AA
Light and dark surfaces resolve through RenDS semantic tokens
Featured suite adopts expectSingleVisibleAffordance, expectAligned, expectWidthRatio, expectNoOverflow, and inspectNativeChrome without dropping block-specific assertions

render-matrix.json declares 10+ states with selector actions (including hover for desktop-light-hover-open) and expectedMarkers; tablet-light-open at 834px is a desktop-shell mega open without .ren-nav-toggle (48rem breakpoint honesty)
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief and cascade map
